audit_metadata.task: Phase 9 Task 4 Final Model Selection Policy Audit

phase6_training_isolation.cv_scheme: Inner 3-fold grouped CV on training partitions only

ranking_degradation_mechanism.root_cause: In binary classification with imbalanced prevalence (8.56%), isotonic regression fits a piecewise constant step function that maps continuous scores into coarse discrete plateaus. This generates massive ties among predictions, destroying continuous ranking resolution and degrading average precision.

policy_verdict.justification: The modest calibration gain (1.54% lower ECE for RF) does not justify risking the 11.3 to 17.5 point collapse in PR-AUC observed with post-hoc calibration, nor does it offset HGB's 38.7% relative recall advantage on cold-start learners. Native log-loss probabilities from HistGradientBoosting remain the approved operational standard.

tau_020_evidence.derivation_source: Train-only F1 optimization across inner CV folds in Phase 5 and Phase 6 (mean tau*=0.21, standardized to 0.20)

tau_010_evidence.derivation_source: High-sensitivity / early-warning threshold evaluated for low-prevalence modules and course onboarding
tau_010_evidence.governance_role: Calibrated Threshold for Module GGG TMAs

module_ggg_specific_justification.evaluation_population: 5,656 matched actionable TMA snapshots (411 failures, prevalence 7.27%)
module_ggg_specific_justification.justification_summary: In Module GGG, tau=0.20 suffered from an 80.29% FNR due to decoupled zero-weight practice quizzes and absent early grades. Calibrating to tau=0.10 more than doubled sensitivity (from 19.71% to 45.74%) at an operationally manageable 17.84% alert volume.

module_generalization_guardrail.governance_mandate: Do NOT generalize GGG's 0.10 threshold to other low-prevalence modules without course-specific matched evaluation. Modules EEE and FFF maintain balanced 35-38% precision and ~45% recall under tau=0.20. Lowering tau to 0.10 across all modules would induce severe false-positive alert fatigue.

operational_concerns: CMAs are frequent, short-cycle, self-paced, or formative automated computer quizzes.
In Module GGG, CMAs carry 0% course credit and are completely decoupled from exam completion.
Mobilizing human advisor phone outreach for automated quizzes causes severe alert fatigue.
High offline PR-AUC reflects statistical association with platform activity, not actionable advisor intervention efficacy.
governance_mandates: Preserve ModuleGGGGovernanceRouter policy: fully suppress alerts on decoupled GGG CMAs.
Classify all CMA snapshot metrics strictly as 'Research-Only Telemetry'.
Prohibit automated counselor outreach triggered by CMA predictions across all modules.

primary_candidate.role: Primary At-Risk Early Warning & Ranking Engine
strengths: Superior cold-start sensitivity (Recall@0.20 = 27.07% vs 19.51% for RF), catching 38.7% more failing students.
Native tree missingness routing without imputation distortion.
Highest responsiveness to short-term pre-deadline VLE telemetry (+0.0387 PR-AUC at 1d horizon).

challenger_candidate.role: Comparative Challenger for Generalization & Probability Calibration
strengths: Leading prospective chronological holdout ranking in 2014J (PR-AUC 0.3093 vs 0.3005 for HGB).
Smaller generalization drop from CV to holdout (Delta = -0.1275 vs -0.1601).

baseline_candidate.role: Retained Offline Linear Baseline & Sanity Check
baseline_candidate.status: Rejected for Operational Deployment; Retained as Scientific Baseline
baseline_candidate.rationale: Catastrophic collapse on cold-start learners (Recall@0.20 = 0.00%, FNR = 100.0%) due to median imputation distortion. Cannot model non-linear VLE engagement patterns. Retained strictly as an offline linear benchmark.

production_approval_boundary.offline_research_status: HistGradientBoosting is certified as the scientifically best-performing primary candidate.
mandatory_production_prerequisites: Complete Phase 9 Task 5: Operational Integration and Deployment Readiness Verification.
Verify counseling center operational capacity against prospective alert volumes (9,227 alerts across 2014J).
Implement and test ModuleGGGGovernanceRouter within real-time inference pipelines.
Establish live data latency and VLE telemetry validation gates.
Conduct shadow-mode operational pilot alongside counselors prior to automated workflow activation.
